يقتطعوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَطِعُوا (yaqtaṭiʕū) /jaq.ta.tˤi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# يُقْتَطَعُوا (yuqtaṭaʕū) /juq.ta.tˤa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
